song_craft: Voice: stotra-address couplets — Abhinavagupta’s own hymn, first person throughout, vocatives load-bearing every verse (row 7). Arc: veneration-by-becoming (v1) → two-step recognition (v2) → fear-denied-suffering-kept (v3) → death defied (v4) → fearlessness finished (v5) → awakening→ingress (v6) → affliction-as-occasion (v7) → rites relativized (v8) → dancing consciousness (v9) → dated seal cooling the world (v10). Recognition performed, not argued. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: Truly, Śaṅkara — vow, giving, bathing, austerity: they dispel becoming’s heat.
But contemplating Your scripture as supreme nectar pours a bliss-stream in the mind.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śaṅkara satyam idam vratadānasnānatapaḥ bhavatāpavidāri tāvakaśāstra parāmṛtacintā cetasi nirvṛtidhārām syandati

verses.craft: Two-means-two-results; rites relativized-not-despised (But-hinge kept); vadeśakālam open.
verses.rejected: (a) despising rites → killed: relativized. (b) cutting But → killed: hinge is the doctrine.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ["Whether 'vadeśakālam' is obscure or means 'place-and-time under control' is unresolved.", 'Whether the rites are listed exhaustively or exemplarily is unresolved.']) / C1 essence / rasa śānta (tranquility) / L2+L3 voice
